request.name: Assign or Reassign a Route by external id

description.content: Assign a route to a provider, driver group (contract), courier, or vehicle. Driver group / courier / vehicle accept an internal or external id. Pre-dispatch the assignment is updated in place. Post-dispatch the route is reassigned — the active assignment is cancelled, live deliveries are cancelled, tasks are recreated and re-quoted, a fresh route assignment is created, and the requested target is applied. Returns the updated route.

response.name: OK
